Dans un milieu favorable, elle reste extrêmement difficile à trouver.

This nectar is found chiefly in cool temperate climates, especially in freshwater banks and shores, and is best known in north-western Endor.

Even in suitable terrain, it remains extremely hard to find.

To obtain its properties, it is used by direct application.

Poured over a burn and left in place for six hours, this nectar numbs the pain and promotes healing. It keeps for up to nine months.
